| <code>pageNumber.decoration</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=16</code><br><code>pattern="^[ -~]+$(?![\\s\\S])"</code> | — |
| <code>typesetting</code> | object | 任意（親指定時） | — | <code>minProperties=1</code><br><code>additionalProperties=false</code> | — |
| <code>typesetting.justification</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |
| <code>typesetting.kinsoku</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |
| <code>typesetting.lineStartForbidden</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=64</code> | — |
| <code>typesetting.lineEndForbidden</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=64</code> | — |
| <code>typesetting.hanging</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |
| <code>typesetting.pushIn</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |
| <code>typesetting.bracketOverlap</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |

制限:

- 1..60000 BMP characters without controls other than LF paragraph breaks or combining marks; paragraphs must be nonempty.
- Up to 2000 characters: multi-paragraph bodies and bodies with annotations are read back character by character before save and after reopen (identity, attributes, start coordinates, empty cursor slots, paragraph ends); this walk is horizontal only. A single paragraph without annotations is compared as the joined GetString(1) lines. About 4.5ms per character per readback stage was measured; macro timeouts scale with length and stages up to 300s.
- Over 2000 characters (CR-003): horizontal text only (no vertical writing), at most 1000 paragraphs. Annotations are allowed; the paragraphs that hold them (at most 2000 characters in total) get the character walk described above, so attributes outside those paragraphs are not read. The whole body is checked before save and after reopen without the character walk: the joined GetString(1) lines equal the text without paragraph breaks, every requested paragraph is a run of whole lines, and a NextParagraph walk checks the first and last character and the end of every paragraph and that no paragraph follows the last. Characters are not read one by one, so a break moved between equal neighbouring characters is not detected; attributes and positions are not read.
- Each sample records how its body was compared: bodyComparison in the run manifest (verification) and in execution-results.json (exact-text, single-paragraph-ignore-readback-line-breaks, range-characters-and-joined-string or long-text-joined-lines-and-paragraph-walk, among others).

## document-style

文書全体の字数・行数・字間・行間・余白と優先モード

status: <code>implemented</code> / requestSupported: <code>true</code>

[Schema / パラメータ参照](../../schemas/sample-catalog.schema.json#/$defs/documentStyle)

document kind: <code>text</code> / 指定場所: <code>document.style</code>

document kind: <code>keisen-table</code> / 指定場所: <code>document.style</code>

document kind: <code>paragraphs</code> / 指定場所: <code>document.style</code>

| parameter / field | 型 | 必須 / 任意 | enum / const | 値域・構造制約 | 条件 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>.</code> | — | 必須 | — | — | oneOf 1: layoutPriority="counts" |
| <code>layoutPriority</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | <code>"counts"</code> | — | oneOf 1: layoutPriority="counts" |
| <code>.</code> | — | 必須 | — | — | oneOf 2: layoutPriority="spacing" |
| <code>layoutPriority</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | <code>"spacing"</code> | — | oneOf 2: layoutPriority="spacing" |

制限:

- Priority settings and all four margins are required. Dependent settings are optional strict assertions; omitted values are calculated and recorded. Spacing is percent; margins are mm. Base: horizontal A4, Yu Mincho regular 10.5pt. Combines with font, page, writingMode, columnFormat, pageNumber and range annotations (text documents), and with keisen-table documents (style only, CR-008); application order is document style base, then font/paper/other document settings, then the requested numeric style values (margins and counts re-applied once if Ichitaro adjusted them), then range annotations. Ichitaro may adjust values that do not fit (for example a larger font with 40 characters and 30mm margins); such samples stop as a readback mismatch with the adjusted values recorded. All requested values must match before save and after reopening. Paper (page) and writing direction (writingMode) may be combined; binding and spread printing are not public parameters.

## document-typesetting

文書スタイルの禁則・ジャスティフィケーション・ぶら下げ・追い込み・括弧類の重なり

status: <code>implemented</code> / requestSupported: <code>true</code>

[Schema / パラメータ参照](../../schemas/sample-catalog.schema.json#/$defs/typesetting)

document kind: <code>text</code> / 指定場所: <code>document.typesetting</code>

document kind: <code>paragraphs</code> / 指定場所: <code>document.typesetting</code>

| parameter / field | 型 | 必須 / 任意 | enum / const | 値域・構造制約 | 条件 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>.</code> | object | 必須 | — | <code>minProperties=1</code><br><code>additionalProperties=false</code> | — |
| <code>justification</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |
| <code>kinsoku</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |
| <code>lineStartForbidden</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=64</code> | — |
| <code>lineEndForbidden</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=64</code> | — |
| <code>hanging</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |
| <code>pushIn</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |
| <code>bracketOverlap</code> | boolean | 任意（親指定時） | — | — | — |

制限:

- Document-style typesetting set with DocumentStyleRoman in one call and read back by GetDocumentStyleRoman before save and after reopen; all twenty getter values are compared between before-save and reopened. Requested: justification on/off (value 2 is rejected by Ichitaro and not offered), kinsoku on/off, complete line-start and line-end forbidden character lists, hanging (ぶら下げ), pushIn (追い込み) and bracketOverlap (括弧類の重なり処理). Observed dependencies: kinsoku false forces the three switches off; hanging true and bracketOverlap false are rejected unless pushIn is false, so requests must state pushIn: false. How lines actually break, hang or squeeze is not measured. 字間の広げ方 writes are not reflected and it is not public; proportional punctuation squeezing (約物の詰め) has no DocumentStyleRoman argument. Other DocumentStyleRoman values (word wrap, hyphenation, base position, line-start shift and the rest) are recorded, not public.

制限:

- One table described by its final state. Up to 2x2 with default sizes and no merges: omitted lineType/color use Ichitaro current settings. Larger tables (up to 4x4), rowHeights (2..4 lines, total &lt;= 9), columnWidths (even 4..10 half-width columns, total &lt;= 18) or merges (up to 4 non-overlapping rectangles) require explicit lineType and color. Tables beyond 2x2 or with merges allow at most fifteen merges, texts and attributes and are drawn rule by rule on the structured path (as is text in rows taller than two lines); other tables allow at most seven texts and attributes. Cell text: nonwhitespace BMP characters, at most min(4, width/2-1) for the final (merged) cell width, one line; a merged cell is addressed by its top-left position. Rules in all eight directions on the bounded grid, every cell attribute and physical cell text lines are read back before save and after reopen. Only explicit type/color values are asserted; unspecified cell attributes inherit the environment. Mixed character formats inside a cell, multi-line cell text, splitting history and physical dimensions in mm are not verified.
- Optional document style (CR-008): chars, lines, margins and priority as for text documents, set and verified on the horizontal base (Yu Mincho regular 10.5pt, A4 portrait) before the table is drawn at the top of the document. Without it the table keeps the new-document form (40x40, 30mm margins). Column widths stay in half-width character units, so their physical width follows the character pitch.
- Optional leading paragraphs (CR-009): 1..8 body paragraphs before the table, each at most 200 characters (empty for a blank line; a long one wraps over several lines) with an optional point size and optional space before/after (mm or percent), and an optional document font (as for text documents, e.g. ＭＳ 明朝). The table starts on the page line after the last paragraph, read at run time (GetRow), and must stay on the first page. Every leading character (identity, type, size), each paragraph end, the page lines each paragraph spans and that they follow each other up to the table, and the requested spacing are read back before save and after reopening; the top and bottom of each paragraph first line and of the canvas first line are recorded (GetPosition, mm), not asserted.

## pdf-from-jtd

既存のJTD（このアプリが作っていない文書）を開いてPDFに保存する（PDF Catalog、1カタログ1000件まで）

status: <code>implemented</code> / requestSupported: <code>true</code>

[Schema / パラメータ参照](../../schemas/pdf-catalog.schema.json)

PDF Catalog v1（Sample Catalog とは別の種別。<code>kind</code>: <code>"pdf-from-jtd"</code>）

| parameter / field | 型 | 必須 / 任意 | enum / const | 値域・構造制約 | 条件 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>.</code> | object | 必須 | — | <code>additionalProperties=false</code> | — |
| <code>schemaVersion</code> | number | 必須 | <code>1</code> | — | — |
| <code>kind</code> | string | 必須 | <code>"pdf-from-jtd"</code> | — | — |
| <code>id</code> | string | 必須 | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=60</code><br><code>pattern="^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$(?![\\s\\S])"</code> | — |
| <code>title</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=200</code> | — |
| <code>purpose</code> | string | 任意（親指定時） | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=2000</code> | — |
| <code>documents</code> | array | 必須 | — | <code>minItems=1</code><br><code>maxItems=1000</code> | — |
| <code>documents[]</code> | object | 必須 | — | <code>additionalProperties=false</code> | — |
| <code>documents[].id</code> | string | 必須 | — | <code>minLength=1</code><br><code>maxLength=60</code><br><code>pattern="^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$(?![\\s\\S])"</code> | — |
| <code>documents[].file</code> | string | 必須 | — | <code>minLength=12</code><br><code>maxLength=127</code><br><code>pattern="^inputs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\\.[Jj][Tt][Dd]$(?![\\s\\S])"</code> | — |
| <code>documents[].sha256</code> | string | 必須 | — | <code>pattern="^[0-9a-f]{64}$(?![\\s\\S])"</code> | — |

制限:

- Separate catalog kind (kind: pdf-from-jtd), not a Sample Catalog document; no baseline is made and nothing in the document is read back or verified. Up to 1000 documents, processed one at a time.
- Each JTD is copied from the input directory into the output directory, and only the copy is opened. A copy whose SHA-256 differs from the catalog is INPUT_MISMATCH; a file that starts neither with the OLE compound file signature (JTD, Ver7, template, compressed) nor with the older Ichitaro signature "DOC" and five NUL bytes (Ver5, Ver6) is NOT_ICHITARO_FORMAT, because other bytes made Ichitaro show a modal dialog. Ichitaro is not started for either.
- One macro run per document: WarningMode(0), OpenDocumentFile, SaveDocument(&lt;pdf&gt;,"","",23) as in --pdf, then GetSheetCount() and CountMacros(2) are recorded, the document is closed without saving (Close(3)) and Ichitaro quits (Quit(3)). The copy's SHA-256 is compared before opening and after closing (JTD_CHANGED when different).
- A macro that reports an error while opening, saving the PDF or closing (OPEN_FAILED, PDF_FAILED, CLOSE_FAILED; reasonCode MACRO_ERROR) is recorded and the batch continues. The outcome is unknown in two cases only, and the batch then stops with the adapter lock left (with its reason) for a person to look at: no completion marker in time (a dialog, for example: TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, the text of the Ichitaro windows is recorded by UI Automation without clicking), or an Ichitaro process still running after the marker (ICHITARO_STILL_RUNNING). Sharing violations (EBUSY, EPERM, EACCES) on any file are retried up to a limit (since 0.17.1); a file still held after that is FILE_BUSY (reasonCode NOT_VERIFIED) and the batch continues.
- A stopped catalog can be resumed (since 0.17.1): documents with an outcome from an earlier attempt are carried over unchanged, and only the stopped document and those not reached are run again.
- The default PDF (document.pdf) holds one sheet: the sheet that was current when the JTD was last saved, not necessarily the main sheet. Since 0.17.0 a document with two or more sheets (GetSheetCount) also gets one PDF per sheet (sheet-&lt;i&gt;.pdf, i counted from the left), saved in the same macro run after the default PDF by ChangeCurrentSheet(i) and the same SaveDocument call; the sheet kind (1 main, 2 Ichitaro sheet, 10 OLE sheet), tab caption and count of text characters (GetString(1) after SelectAll(1); figures and images are not counted, null when it could not be read) are recorded. Since 0.17.2 every sheet is tried even when an earlier one fails; a sheet without a PDF has path null, a reason (EMPTY_SHEET_NOT_SAVED, SAVE_FAILED, SHEET_FAILED, PDF_NOT_WRITTEN, NOT_REACHED) and the message. A save that fails on a sheet with no text characters (EMPTY_SHEET_NOT_SAVED) leaves the document PDF_SAVED; any other sheet without a PDF makes it SHEET_PDF_FAILED (reasonCode MACRO_ERROR, the batch continues), keeping document.pdf and every sheet PDF that was written. OLE sheets were not tried on the real machine.
- The PDF page count is counted from the uncompressed page objects; font substitution and the rendered appearance are not verified.

## paragraph-decoration

段落飾り

status: <code>implemented</code> / requestSupported: <code>false</code>

[Schema / パラメータ参照](../../docs/developer-guide.md)

外部要求のパラメータSchemaはありません。内部Recipe用の情報を外部要求へ転記しないでください。

制限:

- separate from character borders and body ruled lines; internal paragraph Recipe only
- no decoration getter: samples remain saved with reviewRequired=true, never automatically verified
- text and unrelated paragraph attributes checked in every paragraph before save and after reopen; decoration appearance and outside-target leakage require visual review
- clear removes the requested border and fill together; other settings are fixed for each isolated trial; absence of an internal decoration record is not verified
- CancelParagraphDecoration enters interactive start-point selection and is excluded from unattended execution
- standard border width; black fill; no shadow/background; gradient, shadow, fill color, rounding and distance are not exposed; external request API not published
- Not exposed in Sample Catalog v1. Do not request this capability.
